meta.name: fsd-generator
meta.description: Generate comprehensive Functional Specification Documents (FSDs) that translate PRD requirements into implementation-ready specifications. Use when the user needs to create an FSD, functional spec, system specification, or detailed feature specification. Triggers on requests like "create an FSD", "write functional specifications", "translate this PRD into specs", or any request to define system behaviors, data requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria from a PRD or feature description.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成基于产品需求的功能规格文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你手里有产品需求文档,需要把它变成开发团队能直接执行的规格
copy.tagline_en: Turn product requirements into a detailed functional specification.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a product requirements document and need a detailed spec for development.

howto.what: Claude 会把 PRD 转成功能规格说明书(FSD):全局版含系统架构、业务规则、数据字典、API 标准;功能版含逻辑、界面状态、验证规则、边界情况与流程图。
howto.when: 当用户说“创建FSD”“写功能规格”“把PRD转成规格”等,或要求由PRD定义系统行为、数据需求、业务规则等时触发。默认生成全局FSD;指定具体功能时生成该功能的FSD。

say.text: 根据这份PRD创建一个全局FSD。
为登录功能写一份特性FSD。
把这段需求转成功能规格,附验收标准。
say.note: 输出含 Given-When-Then 的规格。

howto.what_en: This skill turns Claude into a senior business analyst that converts PRDs into implementation-ready FSDs. Global FSDs cover system architecture, business rules, data dictionary, and API standards; feature FSDs cover functional logic, UI states, validation rules, edge cases, and Mermaid flows.
howto.when_en: Triggers on requests like 'create an FSD', 'write functional specs', or 'translate PRD to specs', or any ask to define system behaviors/data requirements/business rules. Defaults to global FSD; feature context generates feature FSD.

say_en.text: Create a global FSD from this PRD.
Write a feature FSD for the login function.
Turn this requirement into a functional spec with acceptance criteria.
